_what: What a step with variants keeps of each run, in the pursuit's own database (the step's keep_in), through tool:run-sql-in-my-database, one statement per step. variant_results holds one row per variant per run; the workflow makes the table itself the first time (IF NOT EXISTS), so no setup is needed. cost and tokens are NULL (unknown) when the engine gives none.
table: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS variant_results (workflow text NOT NULL, step text NOT NULL, variant text NOT NULL, run text NOT NULL, at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), measure double precision, cost double precision, tokens bigint, ms bigint, checks_passed boolean NOT NULL, failed_check text, PRIMARY KEY (workflow, step, variant, run))
tally: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variant', v.variant, 'runs', coalesce(t.runs, 0), 'successes', coalesce(t.successes, 0), 'mean_measure', t.mean_measure) ORDER BY v.place), '[]'::jsonb) AS tally, (SELECT count(DISTINCT run)::int FROM variant_results WHERE workflow = $1 AND step = $2) AS total FROM unnest($3::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS v(variant, place) LEFT JOIN (SELECT variant, count(*)::int AS runs, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE checks_passed))::int AS successes, avg(measure) FILTER (WHERE checks_passed) AS mean_measure FROM variant_results WHERE workflow = $1 AND step = $2 GROUP BY variant) t USING (variant)
_tally: $1 the workflow id, $2 the step id, $3 the step's variant ids in order. One row: tally (each variant with its kept runs, the runs that passed their checks and the mean measure of those) and total (the step's kept runs).
keep: WITH this_run AS (SELECT coalesce($3::text, gen_random_uuid()::text) AS id) INSERT INTO variant_results (workflow, step, variant, run, measure, cost, tokens, ms, checks_passed, failed_check) SELECT $1, $2, r.variant, this_run.id, r.measure, r.cost, r.tokens, r.duration_ms, r.checks_passed, left(r.failed_check, 2000) FROM this_run, jsonb_to_recordset(($4::jsonb) -> 'variants') AS r(variant text, measure double precision, cost double precision, tokens bigint, duration_ms bigint, checks_passed boolean, failed_check text) RETURNING run, variant
_keep: $1 the workflow id, $2 the step id, $3 the run's own id (the run input's run_id) or null for a new one, $4 the compare step's answer ({variants, winner}).
